secciones.titulo: Preparation of Porsche vehicles for competition
parrafos: It is a circuit where a Porsche vehicle can demonstrate the ultimate purpose for which it was designed. A machine that transmits unique sensations, incomparable in an urban environment.
Our icons are 8 models that have marked an era in the development of the brand.
Its manufacture began in 1948 until 1966. With versions 356 A, 356 B and 356 C.
In production from 1963 to 1973. 111.995 units were manufactured, with a six-cylinder engine.
The second generation model was manufactured from 1973 to 1989., with a complete overhaul. 198.496 units.

Main new features: 4 traction, ABS system and power steering. It is presented in 1988 with a 3.6 engine with 250 CV dual ignition to achieve greater reliability, the aerodynamic effect is corrected with a retractable rear spoiler.
Presented in 2004, with new circular optics behind an oval transparent cover and more marked wheel arches in the upper area.

The fourth generation represented a notable improvement from a technical point of view and in terms of exterior appearance. With a new 3,6 liter engine with an initial power of 272 CV that increased to 285 CV
In production since 2011 with a flat-six engine with 6 cylinders and with a power of 350 to 700 CV, it represented the highest level of development achieved up to that point.
One of the main changes that it introduced at its time was the water-cooled engine, with rear-wheel drive and a six-speed manual transmission. Six-cylinder engine of 3,4 liters and 300 CV.
